title: Supports of intersections of thick subcategories and proxy smallness
summary: Let R be a commutative noetherian ring. Let D^b(R) be the bounded derived category of finitely generated R-modules. Let X and Y be thick subcategories of D^b(R). In this paper, we consider the question asking when the equality Supp(X\cap Y)=Supp X\cap Supp Y holds, and give several answers. As applications, we obtain a characterization of the proxy small subcategories, and classifications of certain thick subcategories.
